maya-docs: Heads-up — I'm opening a docs PR to clarify function-calling + structured-output guidance. The specific sticking point: how we recommend handling nullable arrays in output schemas (should examples prefer [] or null?). Also need to update SDK snippets (JS + Python) and fix two outdated links. Draft PR: https://redwood.internal/pull/xxxxx

jordan-eng: prefer empty array by default. Null causes subtle parsing branches in many consumers. empty arrays are deterministic and easier to show in examples. + we should include a fallback note for clients that might receive null.

sam-sdk: ok, will prepare JS & Python snippet. suggestion for inline fallback examples:

```javascript
// JS example: safe access to items
const items = Array.isArray(response.items) ? response.items : [];
```

```python
# Python example: safe access
items = response.get("items") if isinstance(response.get("items"), list) else []
```

lee-ml: also recommend we show the JSON Schema union pattern for nullable arrays:

```json
"items": {
  "oneOf": [
    { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" } },
    { "type": "null" }
  ]
}
```

and add a short guardrail: "Prefer array defaults unless external tool output is known to emit null."

maya-docs: thanks — can we also add a short note about function-calling tool outputs and prefer stable enveloping? e.g., always wrap tool outputs in an object with `data` and `error` to avoid positional parsing. Example snippet?

sam-sdk: yes; I'll add an example with tool envelope and the SDK-friendly parse helper. Draft:

```javascript
// tool caller returns { data: {...} }
const payload = response.data ?? {};
const items = Array.isArray(payload.items) ? payload.items : [];
```

jordan-eng: I'll review the runtime docs for backward-compat notes. If there's any production-facing change we need an ops slack heads-up and a canary flag.

maya-docs: who's owning the PR for docs + snippet patch?

sam-sdk: I'll own the PR for snippets, will push branch `docs/nullable-array-snippets` and tag @jordan-eng for review.

doc-bot: PR created: https://redwood.internal/pull/xxxxx — sam-sdk -> docs/nullable-array-snippets :sparkles:

maya-docs: awesome — I'll add the link fixes and a short migration note for customer-facing docs. Target: merge by EOD Friday. :calendar:

jordan-eng: +1, will approve after quick pass.

maya-docs: thanks all — leaving notes in PR for alignment. :thumbsup:
